**User**

---

**Cursor**

### Short answer
- **We need**: a place to run Three.js (simple webpage), your visual specs, and OBS-ready output settings.

### What to decide up front
- **Deployment**: Standalone static page (best for OBS) or integrate into your existing React app.
- **OBS target**: Resolution (e.g., 1920×1080), background (transparent vs solid), FPS cap (30/60).
- **Cubes**: Count (~20), layout (grid/random/orbit), sizes, colors, animation style (spin/bounce), camera (perspective), lighting (ambient + directional).
- **Assets from After Effects**: Are these 2D textures per face? If yes, do you have 6-face images per cube, or 1 atlas? Any alpha?
- **Control**: Do you want to tweak via URL params (e.g., count, speed, color) so different OBS sources can reuse the same page?

### Minimal setup I recommend (fastest path)
- **Standalone, OBS-ready page** using CDN Three.js:
  - Transparent WebGL canvas, fixed 1920×1080, pixel ratio capped.
  - 20 cubes sharing geometry, unique materials or textures if provided.
  - Simple animation loop with low-GC patterns for OBS stability.
  - Optional URL params: `?count=20&speed=1&bg=transparent`.

### What I need from you to start
1. **Placement**: Standalone page (recommended) or inside `apps/million-song-mind`?
2. **OBS specs**: Resolution, transparent vs solid background, target FPS.
3. **Visual**: Cube sizes/colors, layout, animation vibe (spin/bounce/orbit), lighting mood.
4. **AE assets**: Do you want textures on faces? If yes, provide images or a sample.
5. **Hosting**: Use `localhost` as an OBS Browser Source, or deploy (e.g., Vercel)?

If you’re good with the defaults (standalone page, 1920×1080, transparent, 20 cubes in a loose grid, gentle spin, 60 FPS cap), I’ll scaffold it now and you can add it to OBS as a Browser Source immediately.

I want to have quite a level of control over them, and i want each rotation of each cube to be linked to certain chords.  For example, If we chose the key of C, and the C or I cube (they will have a toggle for letter or Roman Numeral Mode), and I touch it or press play, if the cube is in stardard orientation, right side up for example, then it will play a C chord in Root Position.  If that cube was rotated clockwise, then it would be in first inversion, one more rotation so that it is upside downwould be second inversion, one more 90º rotation would be 3rd inversion, and back to Root position for the next rotation.  

The cubes can be free to move around but have a very 'sticky' affinity for 90º rotations, and they always orient to the closest one.  

We will be using an open source software as well to allow computer vision. 
 

I think the repo is git@github.com:collidingScopes/arpeggiator.git

```javascript
import * as THREE from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js';
import { OrbitControls } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js';
import { chordSetsC, inversionByQuarterTurn } from './chords.js';

const canvas = document.getElementById('scene');
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, alpha: true, antialias: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 1.5));
renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(50, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
camera.position.set(0, 4, 12);
const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
controls.enableDamping = true;
controls.enablePan = false;

// Lighting
scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.7));
const dir = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.7);
dir.position.set(3, 5, 4);
scene.add(dir);

// Grid plane for visual reference (can be hidden in OBS)
const grid = new THREE.GridHelper(40, 40, 0x444444, 0x333333);
grid.position.y = -1.5;
scene.add(grid);

// Shared geometry
const cubeSize = 1.2;
const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(cubeSize, cubeSize, cubeSize);

// Generate a canvas texture for labels
function makeLabelTexture(text) {
  const size = 256;
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.width = size;
  canvas.height = size;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  ctx.fillStyle = '#c89f6a'; // wood-ish
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#3b2c1e';
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#2b1c10';
  ctx.lineWidth = 8;
  ctx.strokeRect(10, 10, size - 20, size - 20);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
  ctx.font = 'bold 110px system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial';
  ctx.fillText(text, size / 2, size / 2 + 8);
  const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
  texture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
  texture.needsUpdate = true;
  return texture;
}

function makeMaterials(label) {
  const labelTex = makeLabelTexture(label);
  const wood = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xd5b38a });
  const face = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: labelTex });
  return [face, wood, wood, wood, wood, wood];
}

// State
const cubes = [];
let currentSet = 'major';
let labelMode = 'roman';

// Interaction helpers
const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
const pointer = new THREE.Vector2();
let dragging = null;
let dragOffset = new THREE.Vector3();
const plane = new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), 0);

// Grid snapping
const gridSize = 1.4; // spacing
function snapToGrid(vec3) {
  vec3.x = Math.round(vec3.x / gridSize) * gridSize;
  vec3.z = Math.round(vec3.z / gridSize) * gridSize;
}

function arrangeLinear() {
  const items = cubes;
  const startX = -((items.length - 1) * gridSize) / 2;
  items.forEach((c, i) => {
    c.position.set(startX + i * gridSize, 0, 0);
  });
}

function clearCubes() {
  for (const c of cubes) {
    scene.remove(c);
    c.geometry.dispose();
    c.material.forEach(m => {
      if (m.map) m.map.dispose();
      m.dispose();
    });
  }
  cubes.length = 0;
}

function loadSet(setName) {
  clearCubes();
  const data = chordSetsC[setName];
  for (const item of data) {
    const label = item[labelMode];
    const materials = makeMaterials(label);
    const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry.clone(), materials);
    mesh.userData = {
      roman: item.roman,
      letter: item.letter,
      rotationIndex: 0,
    };
    mesh.position.set((Math.random() - 0.5) * 6, 0, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4);
    cubes.push(mesh);
    scene.add(mesh);
  }
  arrangeLinear();
}

function updateLabels() {
  for (const c of cubes) {
    const label = c.userData[labelMode];
    const materials = makeMaterials(label);
    c.material.forEach(m => { if (m.map) m.map.dispose(); m.dispose(); });
    c.material = materials;
  }
}

// Raycast helpers
function getIntersects(event) {
  const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
  pointer.x = ((event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
  pointer.y = -((event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
  raycaster.setFromCamera(pointer, camera);
  return raycaster.intersectObjects(cubes, false);
}

function onPointerDown(e) {
  const hits = getIntersects(e);
  if (hits.length > 0) {
    dragging = hits[0].object;
    const hitPoint = hits[0].point.clone();
    plane.setFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), dragging.position);
    const worldPoint = new THREE.Vector3();
    raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(plane, worldPoint);
    dragOffset.copy(worldPoint).sub(dragging.position);
    controls.enabled = false;
  }
}

function onPointerMove(e) {
  if (!dragging) return;
  const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
  pointer.x = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
  pointer.y = -((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
  raycaster.setFromCamera(pointer, camera);
  const worldPoint = new THREE.Vector3();
  if (raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(plane, worldPoint)) {
    const target = worldPoint.sub(dragOffset);
    target.y = 0;
    dragging.position.copy(target);
  }
}

function onPointerUp() {
  if (dragging) {
    snapToGrid(dragging.position);
    // simple bunching: nudge overlapping neighbors slightly
    for (const c of cubes) {
      if (c === dragging) continue;
      const d = c.position.distanceTo(dragging.position);
      if (d < gridSize * 0.8) {
        c.position.x += (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1) * gridSize;
        c.position.z += (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1) * gridSize;
        snapToGrid(c.position);
      }
    }
  }
  dragging = null;
  controls.enabled = true;
}

function onClick(e) {
  // If drag ended with minimal move, treat as click
  const hits = getIntersects(e);
  if (hits.length > 0) {
    const obj = hits[0].object;
    obj.userData.rotationIndex = (obj.userData.rotationIndex + 1) % 4;
    const targetY = obj.userData.rotationIndex * (Math.PI / 2);
    obj.rotation.set(0, targetY, 0);
    const inversion = inversionByQuarterTurn[obj.userData.rotationIndex];
    // Placeholder: hook to audio engine later
    console.log('Play chord', { roman: obj.userData.roman, letter: obj.userData.letter, inversion });
  }
}

renderer.domElement.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPointerDown);
renderer.domElement.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove);
window.addEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp);
renderer.domElement.addEventListener('click', onClick);

// UI wiring
const setSelect = document.getElementById('set-select');
const labelSelect = document.getElementById('label-mode');
document.getElementById('arrange-btn').addEventListener('click', arrangeLinear);
document.getElementById('reset-btn').addEventListener('click', () => loadSet(currentSet));

setSelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
  currentSet = setSelect.value;
  loadSet(currentSet);
});

labelSelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
  labelMode = labelSelect.value;
  updateLabels();
});

function onResize() {
  camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
}
window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);

// Initial
loadSet(currentSet);

// Animation loop
function animate() {
  controls.update();
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}
animate();


```

```javascript
export const chordSetsC = {
    major: [
        { roman: 'I', letter: 'C' },
        { roman: 'ii', letter: 'Dm' },
        { roman: 'iii', letter: 'Em' },
        { roman: 'IV', letter: 'F' },
        { roman: 'V', letter: 'G' },
        { roman: 'vi', letter: 'Am' },
        { roman: 'viiø', letter: 'Bø' },
    ],
    applied: [
        { roman: 'I7', letter: 'C7' },
        { roman: 'iiiø', letter: 'Eø' },
        { roman: 'II(7)', letter: 'D(7)' },
        { roman: '#ivø', letter: 'F#ø' },
        { roman: 'III(7)', letter: 'E(7)' },
        { roman: '#vº', letter: 'G#º' },
        { roman: 'VI(7)', letter: 'A(7)' },
        { roman: '#iº', letter: 'C#º' },
        { roman: 'VII(7)', letter: 'B(7)' },
        { roman: '#iiº', letter: 'D#º' },
    ],
    minor: [
        { roman: 'i', letter: 'Cm' },
        { roman: 'iiø', letter: 'Dø' },
        { roman: 'bIII', letter: 'Eb' },
        { roman: 'iv', letter: 'Fm' },
        { roman: 'v', letter: 'Gm' },
        { roman: 'bVI', letter: 'Ab' },
        { roman: 'bVII', letter: 'Bb' },
        { roman: 'V(7)(b9)', letter: 'G(7)(b9)' },
        { roman: 'viiº7', letter: 'Bº7' },
    ],
    all: [],
};

// Combine into an 'all' view
chordSetsC.all = [...chordSetsC.major, ...chordSetsC.applied, ...chordSetsC.minor];

// Mapping from rotation index -> inversion name
export const inversionByQuarterTurn = [
    'root', // 0°
    'first', // 90°
    'second', // 180°
    'third', // 270°
```

```javascript
import * as THREE from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js';
import { OrbitControls } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js';
import { chordSetsC, inversionByQuarterTurn } from './chords.js';

const canvas = document.getElementById('scene');
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, alpha: true, antialias: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 1.5));
renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(50, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
camera.position.set(0, 4, 12);
const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
controls.enableDamping = true;
controls.enablePan = false;

// Lighting
scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.7));
const dir = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.7);
dir.position.set(3, 5, 4);
scene.add(dir);

// Grid plane for visual reference (can be hidden in OBS)
const grid = new THREE.GridHelper(40, 40, 0x444444, 0x333333);
grid.position.y = -1.5;
scene.add(grid);

// Shared geometry
const cubeSize = 1.2;
const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(cubeSize, cubeSize, cubeSize);

// Generate a canvas texture for labels
function makeLabelTexture(text) {
    const size = 256;
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = size;
    canvas.height = size;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c89f6a'; // wood-ish
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3b2c1e';
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#2b1c10';
    ctx.lineWidth = 8;
    ctx.strokeRect(10, 10, size - 20, size - 20);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
    ctx.font = 'bold 110px system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial';
    ctx.fillText(text, size / 2, size / 2 + 8);
    const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
    texture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
    texture.needsUpdate = true;
    return texture;
}

function makeMaterials(label) {
    const labelTex = makeLabelTexture(label);
    const wood = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xd5b38a });
    const face = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: labelTex });
    return [face, wood, wood, wood, wood, wood];
}

// State
const cubes = [];
let currentSet = 'major';
let labelMode = 'roman';
let textureManifest = null;

// Interaction helpers
const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
const pointer = new THREE.Vector2();
let dragging = null;
let dragOffset = new THREE.Vector3();
const plane = new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), 0);

// Grid snapping
const gridSize = 1.4; // spacing
function snapToGrid(vec3) {
    vec3.x = Math.round(vec3.x / gridSize) * gridSize;
    vec3.z = Math.round(vec3.z / gridSize) * gridSize;
}

function arrangeLinear() {
    const items = cubes;
    const startX = -((items.length - 1) * gridSize) / 2;
    items.forEach((c, i) => {
        c.position.set(startX + i * gridSize, 0, 0);
    });
}

function clearCubes() {
    for (const c of cubes) {
        scene.remove(c);
        c.geometry.dispose();
        c.material.forEach(m => {
            if (m.map) m.map.dispose();
            m.dispose();
        });
    }
    cubes.length = 0;
}

function loadSet(setName) {
    clearCubes();
    const data = chordSetsC[setName];
    for (const item of data) {
        const label = item[labelMode];
        const materials = makeMaterials(label);
        const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry.clone(), materials);
        mesh.userData = {
            roman: item.roman,
            letter: item.letter,
            rotationIndex: 0,
        };
        mesh.position.set((Math.random() - 0.5) * 6, 0, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4);
        cubes.push(mesh);
        scene.add(mesh);
    }
    arrangeLinear();
}

function updateLabels() {
    for (const c of cubes) {
        const label = c.userData[labelMode];
        const materials = makeMaterials(label);
        c.material.forEach(m => { if (m.map) m.map.dispose(); m.dispose(); });
        c.material = materials;
    }
}

// Raycast helpers
function getIntersects(event) {
    const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    pointer.x = ((event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
    pointer.y = -((event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
    raycaster.setFromCamera(pointer, camera);
    return raycaster.intersectObjects(cubes, false);
}

function onPointerDown(e) {
    const hits = getIntersects(e);
    if (hits.length > 0) {
        dragging = hits[0].object;
        const hitPoint = hits[0].point.clone();
        plane.setFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), dragging.position);
        const worldPoint = new THREE.Vector3();
        raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(plane, worldPoint);
        dragOffset.copy(worldPoint).sub(dragging.position);
        controls.enabled = false;
    }
}

function onPointerMove(e) {
    if (!dragging) return;
    const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    pointer.x = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
    pointer.y = -((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
    raycaster.setFromCamera(pointer, camera);
    const worldPoint = new THREE.Vector3();
    if (raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(plane, worldPoint)) {
        const target = worldPoint.sub(dragOffset);
        target.y = 0;
        dragging.position.copy(target);
    }
}

function onPointerUp() {
    if (dragging) {
        snapToGrid(dragging.position);
        // simple bunching: nudge overlapping neighbors slightly
        for (const c of cubes) {
            if (c === dragging) continue;
            const d = c.position.distanceTo(dragging.position);
            if (d < gridSize * 0.8) {
                c.position.x += (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1) * gridSize;
                c.position.z += (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1) * gridSize;
                snapToGrid(c.position);
            }
        }
    }
    dragging = null;
    controls.enabled = true;
}

function onClick(e) {
    // If drag ended with minimal move, treat as click
    const hits = getIntersects(e);
    if (hits.length > 0) {
        const obj = hits[0].object;
        obj.userData.rotationIndex = (obj.userData.rotationIndex + 1) % 4;
        const targetY = obj.userData.rotationIndex * (Math.PI / 2);
        obj.rotation.set(0, targetY, 0);
        const inversion = inversionByQuarterTurn[obj.userData.rotationIndex];
        // Placeholder: hook to audio engine later
        console.log('Play chord', { roman: obj.userData.roman, letter: obj.userData.letter, inversion });
    }
}

renderer.domElement.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPointerDown);
renderer.domElement.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove);
window.addEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp);
renderer.domElement.addEventListener('click', onClick);

// UI wiring
const setSelect = document.getElementById('set-select');
const labelSelect = document.getElementById('label-mode');
document.getElementById('arrange-btn').addEventListener('click', arrangeLinear);
document.getElementById('reset-btn').addEventListener('click', () => loadSet(currentSet));

setSelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
    currentSet = setSelect.value;
    loadSet(currentSet);
});

labelSelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
    labelMode = labelSelect.value;
    updateLabels();
});

function onResize() {
    camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
}
window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);

// Initial
loadSet(currentSet);

// Animation loop
function animate() {
    controls.update();
    renderer.render(scene, camera);
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}
animate();



```

```javascript
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
    ctx.font = 'bold 110px system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial';
    ctx.fillText(text, size / 2, size / 2 + 8);
    const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
    texture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
    texture.needsUpdate = true;
    return texture;
}

function loadFaceTexture(label) {
    const url = textureManifest && textureManifest[label];
    if (!url) return Promise.resolve(makeLabelTexture(label));
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const loader = new THREE.TextureLoader();
        loader.load(url, tex => {
            tex.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
            resolve(tex);
        }, undefined, () => resolve(makeLabelTexture(label)));
    });
}

async function makeMaterials(label) {
    const labelTex = await loadFaceTexture(label);
    const wood = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xd5b38a });
    const face = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: labelTex, transparent: true });
    return [face, wood, wood, wood, wood, wood];
}

// State
const cubes = [];
let currentSet = 'major';
let labelMode = 'roman';
let textureManifest = null;

// Interaction helpers
const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
const pointer = new THREE.Vector2();
let dragging = null;
let dragOffset = new THREE.Vector3();
const plane = new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), 0);

// Grid snapping
const gridSize = 1.4; // spacing
function snapToGrid(vec3) {
    vec3.x = Math.round(vec3.x / gridSize) * gridSize;
    vec3.z = Math.round(vec3.z / gridSize) * gridSize;
}

function arrangeLinear() {
    const items = cubes;
    const startX = -((items.length - 1) * gridSize) / 2;
    items.forEach((c, i) => {
        c.position.set(startX + i * gridSize, 0, 0);
    });
}

function clearCubes() {
    for (const c of cubes) {
        scene.remove(c);
        c.geometry.dispose();
        c.material.forEach(m => {
            if (m.map) m.map.dispose();
            m.dispose();
        });
    }
    cubes.length = 0;
}

async function loadSet(setName) {
    clearCubes();
    const data = chordSetsC[setName];
    for (const item of data) {
        const label = item[labelMode];
        const materials = await makeMaterials(label);
        const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry.clone(), materials);
        mesh.userData = {
            roman: item.roman,
            letter: item.letter,
            rotationIndex: 0,
        };
        mesh.position.set((Math.random() - 0.5) * 6, 0, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4);
        cubes.push(mesh);
        scene.add(mesh);
    }
    arrangeLinear();
}

async function updateLabels() {
    for (const c of cubes) {
        const label = c.userData[labelMode];
        const materials = await makeMaterials(label);
        c.material.forEach(m => { if (m.map) m.map.dispose(); m.dispose(); });
        c.material = materials;
    }
}

// Raycast helpers
function getIntersects(event) {
    const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    pointer.x = ((event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
    pointer.y = -((event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
    raycaster.setFromCamera(pointer, camera);
    return raycaster.intersectObjects(cubes, false);
}

function onPointerDown(e) {
    const hits = getIntersects(e);
    if (hits.length > 0) {
        dragging = hits[0].object;
        const hitPoint = hits[0].point.clone();
        plane.setFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), dragging.position);
        const worldPoint = new THREE.Vector3();
        raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(plane, worldPoint);
        dragOffset.copy(worldPoint).sub(dragging.position);
        controls.enabled = false;
    }
}

function onPointerMove(e) {
    if (!dragging) return;
    const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    pointer.x = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
    pointer.y = -((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
    raycaster.setFromCamera(pointer, camera);
    const worldPoint = new THREE.Vector3();
    if (raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(plane, worldPoint)) {
        const target = worldPoint.sub(dragOffset);
        target.y = 0;
        dragging.position.copy(target);
    }
}

function onPointerUp() {
    if (dragging) {
        snapToGrid(dragging.position);
        // simple bunching: nudge overlapping neighbors slightly
        for (const c of cubes) {
            if (c === dragging) continue;
            const d = c.position.distanceTo(dragging.position);
            if (d < gridSize * 0.8) {
                c.position.x += (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1) * gridSize;
                c.position.z += (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1) * gridSize;
                snapToGrid(c.position);
            }
        }
    }
    dragging = null;
    controls.enabled = true;
}

function onClick(e) {
    // If drag ended with minimal move, treat as click
    const hits = getIntersects(e);
    if (hits.length > 0) {
        const obj = hits[0].object;
        obj.userData.rotationIndex = (obj.userData.rotationIndex + 1) % 4;
        const targetY = obj.userData.rotationIndex * (Math.PI / 2);
        obj.rotation.set(0, targetY, 0);
        const inversion = inversionByQuarterTurn[obj.userData.rotationIndex];
        // Placeholder: hook to audio engine later
        console.log('Play chord', { roman: obj.userData.roman, letter: obj.userData.letter, inversion });
    }
}

renderer.domElement.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPointerDown);
renderer.domElement.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove);
window.addEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp);
renderer.domElement.addEventListener('click', onClick);

// UI wiring
const setSelect = document.getElementById('set-select');
const labelSelect = document.getElementById('label-mode');
document.getElementById('arrange-btn').addEventListener('click', arrangeLinear);
document.getElementById('reset-btn').addEventListener('click', () => loadSet(currentSet));

setSelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
    currentSet = setSelect.value;
    loadSet(currentSet);
});

labelSelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
    labelMode = labelSelect.value;
    updateLabels();
});

function onResize() {
    camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
}
window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);

// Initial
loadSet(currentSet);

// Animation loop
function animate() {
    controls.update();
    renderer.render(scene, camera);
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}
animate();
```

- Drop files into `apps/million-song-mind/public/obs-cubes/textures/` and map them in `manifest.json` as label → file path (roman or letter labels depending on the current mode). Missing entries fall back to the canvas-rendered label.

```javascript
    const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    pointer.x = ((event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
    pointer.y = -((event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
    raycaster.setFromCamera(pointer, camera);
    return raycaster.intersectObjects(cubes, false);
}

function onPointerDown(e) {
    const hits = getIntersects(e);
    if (hits.length > 0) {
        dragging = hits[0].object;
        const hitPoint = hits[0].point.clone();
        plane.setFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), dragging.position);
        const worldPoint = new THREE.Vector3();
        raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(plane, worldPoint);
        dragOffset.copy(worldPoint).sub(dragging.position);
        controls.enabled = false;
    }
}

function onPointerMove(e) {
    if (!dragging) return;
    const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    pointer.x = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
    pointer.y = -((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
    raycaster.setFromCamera(pointer, camera);
    const worldPoint = new THREE.Vector3();
    if (raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(plane, worldPoint)) {
        const target = worldPoint.sub(dragOffset);
        target.y = 0;
        dragging.position.copy(target);
    }
}

function onPointerUp() {
    if (dragging) {
        snapToGrid(dragging.position);
        // simple bunching: nudge overlapping neighbors slightly
        for (const c of cubes) {
            if (c === dragging) continue;
            const d = c.position.distanceTo(dragging.position);
            if (d < gridSize * 0.8) {
                c.position.x += (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1) * gridSize;
                c.position.z += (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1) * gridSize;
                snapToGrid(c.position);
            }
        }
    }
    dragging = null;
    controls.enabled = true;
}

function onClick(e) {
    // If drag ended with minimal move, treat as click
    const hits = getIntersects(e);
    if (hits.length > 0) {
        const obj = hits[0].object;
        obj.userData.rotationIndex = (obj.userData.rotationIndex + 1) % 4;
        const targetY = obj.userData.rotationIndex * (Math.PI / 2);
        obj.rotation.set(0, targetY, 0);
        const inversion = inversionByQuarterTurn[obj.userData.rotationIndex];
        // Placeholder: hook to audio engine later
        console.log('Play chord', { roman: obj.userData.roman, letter: obj.userData.letter, inversion });
    }
}

renderer.domElement.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPointerDown);
renderer.domElement.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove);
window.addEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp);
renderer.domElement.addEventListener('click', onClick);

// UI wiring
const setSelect = document.getElementById('set-select');
const labelSelect = document.getElementById('label-mode');
document.getElementById('arrange-btn').addEventListener('click', arrangeLinear);
document.getElementById('reset-btn').addEventListener('click', () => loadSet(currentSet));

setSelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
    currentSet = setSelect.value;
    loadSet(currentSet);
});

labelSelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
    labelMode = labelSelect.value;
    updateLabels();
});

function onResize() {
    camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
}
window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);

// Initial: try to load texture manifest mapping { label: url }
fetch('./textures/manifest.json')
    .then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : null)
    .then(j => { textureManifest = j || null; loadSet(currentSet); })
    .catch(() => loadSet(currentSet));

// Animation loop
function animate() {
    controls.update();
    renderer.render(scene, camera);
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}
animate();
```

NOw they have to have an extrememe bias for being in the center, the same positioning as in the template picture i sent.  We can move them around wherever, but if they are part of the active selection, then they will all want to be in the center.  If there is already a cube in the 'center' x/y position, then they will 'click in' next to it, perfectly aligned, as close as they can get to the center from the position they were at.  If there are 10 cubes, the cube, should it be slightly to the right of center, would then find itself the rightmost cube in the conected line of cubes, therefore the 11th cube. If i was to pull out the center cube, the rest would close in that empty space, and then releasing the previoulsy center cube would force it to the 'end of the line', either the leftmost (1st cube) or the rightmost (new 11th cube). Does that make sense?  straighforward kids cube logic.

**Cursor**

I'll implement the center-biased lineup and slotting behavior: cubes in the active set form a centered row; dragging one pulls it out and closes the gap; on release it joins the nearest end (left/right) and re-centers the line. Then I'll reload the page.

```javascript
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';
import { chordSetsC, inversionByQuarterTurn } from './chords.js';

const canvas = document.getElementById('scene');
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, alpha: true, antialias: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 1.5));
renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(50, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
camera.position.set(0, 4, 12);
const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
controls.enableDamping = true;
controls.enablePan = false;

// Lighting
scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.7));
const dir = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.7);
dir.position.set(3, 5, 4);
scene.add(dir);

// Grid plane for visual reference (can be hidden in OBS)
const grid = new THREE.GridHelper(40, 40, 0x444444, 0x333333);
grid.position.y = -1.5;
scene.add(grid);

// Shared geometry
const cubeSize = 1.2;
const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(cubeSize, cubeSize, cubeSize);

// Generate a canvas texture for labels
function makeLabelTexture(text) {
    const size = 256;
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = size;
    canvas.height = size;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c89f6a'; // wood-ish
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3b2c1e';
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#2b1c10';
    ctx.lineWidth = 8;
    ctx.strokeRect(10, 10, size - 20, size - 20);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
    ctx.font = 'bold 110px system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial';
    ctx.fillText(text, size / 2, size / 2 + 8);
    const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
    texture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
    texture.needsUpdate = true;
    return texture;
}

function loadFaceTexture(label) {
    const url = textureManifest && textureManifest[label];
    if (!url) return Promise.resolve(makeLabelTexture(label));
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const loader = new THREE.TextureLoader();
        loader.load(url, tex => {
            tex.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
            resolve(tex);
        }, undefined, () => resolve(makeLabelTexture(label)));
    });
}

async function makeMaterials(label) {
    const labelTex = await loadFaceTexture(label);
    const wood = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xd5b38a });
    const face = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: labelTex, transparent: true });
    return [face, wood, wood, wood, wood, wood];
}

// State
const cubes = [];
let currentSet = 'major';
let labelMode = 'roman';
let textureManifest = null;

// Interaction helpers
const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
const pointer = new THREE.Vector2();
let dragging = null;
let dragOffset = new THREE.Vector3();
const plane = new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), 0);

// Grid snapping and lineup spacing
const gridSize = 1.4; // spacing between cubes
function snapToGrid(vec3) {
    vec3.x = Math.round(vec3.x / gridSize) * gridSize;
    vec3.z = Math.round(vec3.z / gridSize) * gridSize;
}

// Active lineup management
let lineup = [];

function computeSlotPositions(n) {
    const startX = -((n - 1) * gridSize) / 2;
    const xs = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) xs.push(startX + i * gridSize);
    return xs;
}

function reflowLineup() {
    const xs = computeSlotPositions(lineup.length);
    lineup.forEach((cube, i) => {
        cube.position.x = xs[i];
        cube.position.y = 0;
        cube.position.z = 0;
    });
}

function removeFromLineup(obj) {
    const idx = lineup.indexOf(obj);
    if (idx >= 0) {
        lineup.splice(idx, 1);
        reflowLineup();
    }
}

function addToLineup(obj, side) {
    if (lineup.includes(obj)) return;
    if (side === 'left') lineup.unshift(obj);
    else lineup.push(obj);
    reflowLineup();
}

function clearCubes() {
    for (const c of cubes) {
        scene.remove(c);
        c.geometry.dispose();
        c.material.forEach(m => {
            if (m.map) m.map.dispose();
            m.dispose();
        });
    }
    cubes.length = 0;
    lineup = [];
}

async function loadSet(setName) {
    clearCubes();
    const data = chordSetsC[setName];
    for (const item of data) {
        const label = item[labelMode];
        const materials = await makeMaterials(label);
        const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry.clone(), materials);
        mesh.userData = {
            roman: item.roman,
            letter: item.letter,
            rotationIndex: 0,
        };
        mesh.position.set((Math.random() - 0.5) * 6, 0, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4);
        cubes.push(mesh);
        scene.add(mesh);
    }
    lineup = [...cubes];
    reflowLineup();
}

async function updateLabels() {
    for (const c of cubes) {
        const label = c.userData[labelMode];
        const materials = await makeMaterials(label);
        c.material.forEach(m => { if (m.map) m.map.dispose(); m.dispose(); });
        c.material = materials;
    }
}

// Raycast helpers
function getIntersects(event) {
    const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    pointer.x = ((event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
    pointer.y = -((event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
    raycaster.setFromCamera(pointer, camera);
    return raycaster.intersectObjects(cubes, false);
}

function onPointerDown(e) {
    const hits = getIntersects(e);
    if (hits.length > 0) {
        dragging = hits[0].object;
        const hitPoint = hits[0].point.clone();
        plane.setFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), dragging.position);
        const worldPoint = new THREE.Vector3();
        raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(plane, worldPoint);
        dragOffset.copy(worldPoint).sub(dragging.position);
        controls.enabled = false;
    }
}

function onPointerMove(e) {
    if (!dragging) return;
    const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    pointer.x = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
    pointer.y = -((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
    raycaster.setFromCamera(pointer, camera);
    const worldPoint = new THREE.Vector3();
    if (raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(plane, worldPoint)) {
        const target = worldPoint.sub(dragOffset);
        target.y = 0;
        dragging.position.copy(target);
    }
}

function onPointerUp() {
    if (dragging) {
        // Insert back into lineup at nearest end by x sign (right/left)
        const side = dragging.position.x >= 0 ? 'right' : 'left';
        addToLineup(dragging, side);
    }
    dragging = null;
    controls.enabled = true;
}

function onClick(e) {
    // If drag ended with minimal move, treat as click
    const hits = getIntersects(e);
    if (hits.length > 0) {
        const obj = hits[0].object;
        obj.userData.rotationIndex = (obj.userData.rotationIndex + 1) % 4;
        const targetY = obj.userData.rotationIndex * (Math.PI / 2);
        obj.rotation.set(0, targetY, 0);
        const inversion = inversionByQuarterTurn[obj.userData.rotationIndex];
        // Placeholder: hook to audio engine later
        console.log('Play chord', { roman: obj.userData.roman, letter: obj.userData.letter, inversion });
    }
}

renderer.domElement.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
    const hits = getIntersects(e);
    if (hits.length > 0) {
        dragging = hits[0].object;
        // Remove from lineup immediately so others close the gap
        removeFromLineup(dragging);
        const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
        pointer.x = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
        pointer.y = -((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
        raycaster.setFromCamera(pointer, camera);
        const worldPoint = new THREE.Vector3();
        plane.setFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), dragging.position);
        raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(plane, worldPoint);
        dragOffset.copy(worldPoint).sub(dragging.position);
        controls.enabled = false;
    }
});
renderer.domElement.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove);
window.addEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp);
renderer.domElement.addEventListener('click', onClick);

// UI wiring
const setSelect = document.getElementById('set-select');
const labelSelect = document.getElementById('label-mode');
document.getElementById('arrange-btn').addEventListener('click', reflowLineup);
document.getElementById('reset-btn').addEventListener('click', () => loadSet(currentSet));

setSelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
    currentSet = setSelect.value;
    loadSet(currentSet);
});

labelSelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
    labelMode = labelSelect.value;
    updateLabels();
});

function onResize() {
    camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
}
window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);

// Initial: try to load texture manifest mapping { label: url }
fetch('./textures/manifest.json')
    .then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : null)
    .then(j => { textureManifest = j || null; loadSet(currentSet); })
    .catch(() => loadSet(currentSet));

// Animation loop
function animate() {
    controls.update();
    renderer.render(scene, camera);
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}
animate();
```

- Added “kids block” lineup logic: active cubes auto-form a centered row. Dragging a cube removes it from the row and closes the gap; releasing reattaches it to the nearest end (left/right) and recenters the line.
- Reload `http://localhost:8080/obs-cubes/index.html` to test:
  - Drag a cube away: others close in.
  - Release on right side: it becomes the rightmost; on left: leftmost.
  - Click still rotates 90° with inversion mapping.

If you want gaps or multi-row behavior next, I can add slot reservations and lane wrapping.

**User**

fantastic.  Add an extreme bias for the chord name face, always facing front to the user. The other faces will be two layers, the chord tones and the scale degrees/letter note names.  When the chord name is facing the user, the bottom face will be the Root (green circle indicating Root), the right side will be the 3rd of the chord (red circle indicating 3rd), the top face will be the 5th of the chord (5th represented by a blue circle) and the left face will be the 7th of the chord (off white/greyish circle).  white diamonds will be placed OVERTOP of the circles, the diamonds are the note 'ingredients' of the chords.   so for example, if the I chord was C major, we would see a C diamond on the bottom, the E diamond on the right, the G diamond on the top, and the B diamond on the left, overtop of their respective colors.  If the roman system were toggled, then the C would changeto scale degree 1, the E to scale degree 3, the G to scale degree 5, and the B to scale degree 7.  

If the chord were ii, or D minor,it would be DFAC/2461.  is that clear?   

Major: I, ii, iii, IV, V, vi, viiø
Applied: I7, iiiø, II(7), #ivø, III(7), #vº, VI(7), #iº, VII(7), #iiº, 
Minor: i, iiø, bIII, iv, v, bVI, bVII, V(7)(b9), viiº7

Major: C, Dm, Em, F, G, Am, Bøi,
Applied: C7, Eø, D(7), F#ø, E(7), G#º, A(7), C#º, B(7), D#º, 
Minor: Cm, Dø, Eb, Fm, Gm, Ab, Bb, G(7)(b9) Bº7.  

Chords like III would have to have a #5 obviously, or the G#, because iii minoris 3572, that is with a minor 3rd.  for the roman numeral/chord letter to be MAJOR, the 3rd of the chord is raised a semitone, therefore the ingredients would be 3(#5)72 or E G# B D.

```javascript
// Basic chord datasets for key of C. Extendable later.

export const chordSetsC = {
    major: [
        { roman: 'I', letter: 'C' },
        { roman: 'ii', letter: 'Dm' },
        { roman: 'iii', letter: 'Em' },
        { roman: 'IV', letter: 'F' },
        { roman: 'V', letter: 'G' },
        { roman: 'vi', letter: 'Am' },
        { roman: 'viiø', letter: 'Bø' },
    ],
    applied: [
        { roman: 'I7', letter: 'C7' },
        { roman: 'iiiø', letter: 'Eø' },
        { roman: 'II(7)', letter: 'D(7)' },
        { roman: '#ivø', letter: 'F#ø' },
        { roman: 'III(7)', letter: 'E(7)' },
        { roman: '#vº', letter: 'G#º' },
        { roman: 'VI(7)', letter: 'A(7)' },
        { roman: '#iº', letter: 'C#º' },
        { roman: 'VII(7)', letter: 'B(7)' },
        { roman: '#iiº', letter: 'D#º' },
    ],
    minor: [
        { roman: 'i', letter: 'Cm' },
        { roman: 'iiø', letter: 'Dø' },
        { roman: 'bIII', letter: 'Eb' },
        { roman: 'iv', letter: 'Fm' },
        { roman: 'v', letter: 'Gm' },
        { roman: 'bVI', letter: 'Ab' },
        { roman: 'bVII', letter: 'Bb' },
        { roman: 'V(7)(b9)', letter: 'G(7)(b9)' },
        { roman: 'viiº7', letter: 'Bº7' },
    ],
    all: [],
};

// Combine into an 'all' view
chordSetsC.all = [...chordSetsC.major, ...chordSetsC.applied, ...chordSetsC.minor];

// Mapping from rotation index -> inversion name
export const inversionByQuarterTurn = [
    'root', // 0°
    'first', // 90°
    'second', // 180°
    'third', // 270°
];

// Note sets for key of C (letter mode), per chord label (roman side shown for reference)
// Arrays are [root, third, fifth, seventh]
export const noteSetsC = {
    // Diatonic major family
    'I': ['C', 'E', 'G', 'B'],
    'ii': ['D', 'F', 'A', 'C'],
    'iii': ['E', 'G', 'B', 'D'],
    'IV': ['F', 'A', 'C', 'E'],
    'V': ['G', 'B', 'D', 'F'],
    'vi': ['A', 'C', 'E', 'G'],
    'viiø': ['B', 'D', 'F', 'A'],

    // Applied family (dominants/altered/half-dim/dim) relative to C
    'I7': ['C', 'E', 'G', 'Bb'],        // C7
    'III(7)': ['E', 'G#', 'B', 'D'],    // E7
    'II(7)': ['D', 'F#', 'A', 'C'],     // D7
    'VI(7)': ['A', 'C#', 'E', 'G'],     // A7
    'VII(7)': ['B', 'D#', 'F#', 'A'],   // B7
    'iiiø': ['E', 'G', 'Bb', 'D'],      // E half-dim 7
    '#ivø': ['F#', 'A', 'C', 'E'],      // F# half-dim 7
    '#vº': ['G#', 'B', 'D', 'F'],       // G# dim 7
    '#iº': ['C#', 'E', 'G', 'Bb'],      // C# dim 7
    '#iiº': ['D#', 'F#', 'A', 'C'],     // D# dim 7
};

// Degree labels in C major for natural and altered notes
const DEGREE_FOR_NOTE = {
    'C': '1', 'C#': '#1', 'Cb': 'b1',
    'D': '2', 'D#': '#2', 'Db': 'b2',
    'E': '3', 'E#': '#3', 'Eb': 'b3',
    'F': '4', 'F#': '#4', 'Fb': 'b4',
    'G': '5', 'G#': '#5', 'Gb': 'b5',
    'A': '6', 'A#': '#6', 'Ab': 'b6',
    'B': '7', 'B#': '#7', 'Bb': 'b7',
};

export function notesToDegreesInC(notes) {
    return notes.map(n => DEGREE_FOR_NOTE[n] || n);
}
```

```javascript
    canvas.height = size;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c89f6a'; // wood-ish
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3b2c1e';
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#2b1c10';
    ctx.lineWidth = 8;
    ctx.strokeRect(10, 10, size - 20, size - 20);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
    ctx.font = 'bold 110px system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial';
    ctx.fillText(text, size / 2, size / 2 + 8);
    const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
    texture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
    texture.needsUpdate = true;
    return texture;
}

function loadFaceTexture(label) {
    const url = textureManifest && textureManifest[label];
    if (!url) return Promise.resolve(makeLabelTexture(label));
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const loader = new THREE.TextureLoader();
        loader.load(url, tex => {
            tex.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
            resolve(tex);
        }, undefined, () => resolve(makeLabelTexture(label)));
    });
}

function makeCircleDiamondFace(text, color) {
    const size = 256;
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = size; canvas.height = size;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f0e6d8';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);
    // colored circle
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(size/2, size/2, size*0.35, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    // white diamond on top
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(size/2, size/2);
    ctx.rotate(Math.PI/4);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillRect(-size*0.18, -size*0.18, size*0.36, size*0.36);
    ctx.restore();
    // note or degree label
    ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
    ctx.font = 'bold 64px system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(text, size/2, size/2);
    const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
    tex.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
    tex.needsUpdate = true;
    return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: tex, transparent: true });
}

async function makeMaterials(label, romanLabel) {
    // Front face: chord name label texture (strong bias always facing camera)
    const labelTex = await loadFaceTexture(label);
    const front = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: labelTex, transparent: true });
    const wood = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xd5b38a });

    // Determine ingredients (root,3rd,5th,7th)
    const notes = noteSetsC[romanLabel] || ['-', '-', '-', '-'];
    const display = (labelMode === 'roman') ? notesToDegreesInC(notes) : notes;
    const faceBottom = makeCircleDiamondFace(display[0], '#2ecc71'); // root
    const faceRight = makeCircleDiamondFace(display[1], '#e74c3c'); // 3rd
    const faceTop = makeCircleDiamondFace(display[2], '#3498db'); // 5th
    const faceLeft = makeCircleDiamondFace(display[3], '#bdc3c7'); // 7th

    // Face order: [px, nx, py, ny, pz, nz]
    // We'll orient so nz (index 5) is the front-facing chord-name; map sides accordingly
    // left(n x) -> 1; right(p x) -> 0; top(p y) -> 2; bottom(n y) -> 3; front(n z) -> 5; back(p z) -> 4
    const materials = [];
    materials[0] = faceRight; // +x right → 3rd
    materials[1] = faceLeft;  // -x left → 7th
    materials[2] = faceTop;   // +y top → 5th
    materials[3] = faceBottom;// -y bottom → root
    materials[4] = wood;      // +z back
    materials[5] = front;     // -z front chord label
    return materials;
}

// State
const cubes = [];
let currentSet = 'major';
let labelMode = 'roman';
let textureManifest = null;

// Interaction helpers
const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
const pointer = new THREE.Vector2();
let dragging = null;
let dragOffset = new THREE.Vector3();
const plane = new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), 0);

// Grid snapping and lineup spacing
const gridSize = 1.4; // spacing between cubes
function snapToGrid(vec3) {
    vec3.x = Math.round(vec3.x / gridSize) * gridSize;
    vec3.z = Math.round(vec3.z / gridSize) * gridSize;
}

// Active lineup management
let lineup = [];

function computeSlotPositions(n) {
    const startX = -((n - 1) * gridSize) / 2;
    const xs = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) xs.push(startX + i * gridSize);
    return xs;
}

function reflowLineup() {
    const xs = computeSlotPositions(lineup.length);
    lineup.forEach((cube, i) => {
        cube.position.x = xs[i];
        cube.position.y = 0;
        cube.position.z = 0;
    });
}

function removeFromLineup(obj) {
    const idx = lineup.indexOf(obj);
    if (idx >= 0) {
        lineup.splice(idx, 1);
        reflowLineup();
    }
}

function addToLineup(obj, side) {
    if (lineup.includes(obj)) return;
    if (side === 'left') lineup.unshift(obj);
    else lineup.push(obj);
    reflowLineup();
}

function clearCubes() {
    for (const c of cubes) {
        scene.remove(c);
        c.geometry.dispose();
        c.material.forEach(m => {
            if (m.map) m.map.dispose();
            m.dispose();
        });
    }
    cubes.length = 0;
    lineup = [];
}

async function loadSet(setName) {
    clearCubes();
    const data = chordSetsC[setName];
    for (const item of data) {
        const label = item[labelMode];
        const materials = await makeMaterials(label, item.roman);
        const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry.clone(), materials);
        mesh.userData = {
            roman: item.roman,
            letter: item.letter,
            rotationIndex: 0,
        };
        mesh.position.set((Math.random() - 0.5) * 6, 0, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4);
        cubes.push(mesh);
        scene.add(mesh);
    }
    lineup = [...cubes];
    reflowLineup();
}

async function updateLabels() {
    for (const c of cubes) {
        const label = c.userData[labelMode];
        const materials = await makeMaterials(label);
        c.material.forEach(m => { if (m.map) m.map.dispose(); m.dispose(); });
        c.material = materials;
    }
}

// Raycast helpers
function getIntersects(event) {
    const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    pointer.x = ((event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
    pointer.y = -((event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
    raycaster.setFromCamera(pointer, camera);
    return raycaster.intersectObjects(cubes, false);
}

function onPointerDown(e) {
    const hits = getIntersects(e);
    if (hits.length > 0) {
        dragging = hits[0].object;
        const hitPoint = hits[0].point.clone();
        plane.setFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), dragging.position);
        const worldPoint = new THREE.Vector3();
        raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(plane, worldPoint);
        dragOffset.copy(worldPoint).sub(dragging.position);
        controls.enabled = false;
    }
}

function onPointerMove(e) {
    if (!dragging) return;
    const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    pointer.x = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
    pointer.y = -((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
    raycaster.setFromCamera(pointer, camera);
    const worldPoint = new THREE.Vector3();
    if (raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(plane, worldPoint)) {
        const target = worldPoint.sub(dragOffset);
        target.y = 0;
        dragging.position.copy(target);
    }
}

function onPointerUp() {
    if (dragging) {
        // Insert back into lineup at nearest end by x sign (right/left)
        const side = dragging.position.x >= 0 ? 'right' : 'left';
        addToLineup(dragging, side);
    }
    dragging = null;
    controls.enabled = true;
}

function onClick(e) {
    // If drag ended with minimal move, treat as click
    const hits = getIntersects(e);
    if (hits.length > 0) {
        const obj = hits[0].object;
        obj.userData.rotationIndex = (obj.userData.rotationIndex + 1) % 4;
        const inversion = inversionByQuarterTurn[obj.userData.rotationIndex];
        // Do NOT visually rotate the cube; we keep chord face toward camera.
        // In a later step we can animate side-face swapping to reflect inversion if needed.
        console.log('Play chord', { roman: obj.userData.roman, letter: obj.userData.letter, inversion });
    }
}

renderer.domElement.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
    const hits = getIntersects(e);
    if (hits.length > 0) {
        dragging = hits[0].object;
        // Remove from lineup immediately so others close the gap
        removeFromLineup(dragging);
        const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
        pointer.x = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
        pointer.y = -((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
        raycaster.setFromCamera(pointer, camera);
        const worldPoint = new THREE.Vector3();
        plane.setFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), dragging.position);
        raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(plane, worldPoint);
        dragOffset.copy(worldPoint).sub(dragging.position);
        controls.enabled = false;
    }
});
renderer.domElement.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove);
window.addEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp);
renderer.domElement.addEventListener('click', onClick);

// UI wiring
const setSelect = document.getElementById('set-select');
const labelSelect = document.getElementById('label-mode');
document.getElementById('arrange-btn').addEventListener('click', reflowLineup);
document.getElementById('reset-btn').addEventListener('click', () => loadSet(currentSet));

setSelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
    currentSet = setSelect.value;
    loadSet(currentSet);
});

labelSelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
    labelMode = labelSelect.value;
    updateLabels();
});

function onResize() {
    camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
}
window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);

// Initial: try to load texture manifest mapping { label: url }
fetch('./textures/manifest.json')
    .then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : null)
    .then(j => { textureManifest = j || null; loadSet(currentSet); })
    .catch(() => loadSet(currentSet));

// Animation loop
function animate() {
    controls.update();
    renderer.render(scene, camera);
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}
animate();



```

- I added “front-face bias”: the chord-name face always faces the viewer; clicks change inversion logically without spinning the cube.
- Each cube now renders:
  - Front: chord name (Roman or Letter per toggle).
  - Bottom: Root (green circle) with a white diamond and the note/degree.
  - Right: 3rd (red).
  - Top: 5th (blue).
  - Left: 7th (grey).
- The note diamonds are computed from the key of C for your Major/Applied/Minor sets; in Roman mode they show degrees (1/3/5/7, with accidentals) instead of letters.

Try it: reload `http://localhost:8080/obs-cubes/index.html`, switch Roman/Letter, click a cube to cycle inversion (logged). If you want the side faces to swap content visually with inversions rather than just logical playback, I can implement animated face remapping next.

---

**User**

Looking good, the chord name face however is on whati would consider the 'backside'.  If the chord name text were to be moved to the other side of the cube, then we would be in much better shape.  The standard viewpoint ofthe user will be 45 degrees below 'ground' looking up at the cubes so thatthe bottom face and 'front' chord nameface are both visible as in the template screenshot.  Therefore, the 'scale degree' or diamonds must be right way up as well.  If the chord name face were to go on the opposite side and NOTHING else were to change, the bottom diamond will be in the correct, right way up legible position.  

---

**Cursor**

I’m swapping the chord-name face from the cube’s -Z side to +Z so it faces the camera while keeping the other sides unchanged. This should make the bottom diamond read upright from your standard angle. I'll implement this now.

```javascript
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';
import { chordSetsC, inversionByQuarterTurn, noteSetsC, notesToDegreesInC } from './chords.js';

const canvas = document.getElementById('scene');
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, alpha: true, antialias: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 1.5));
renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(50, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
camera.position.set(0, 4, 12);
const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
controls.enableDamping = true;
controls.enablePan = false;

// Lighting
scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.7));
const dir = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.7);
dir.position.set(3, 5, 4);
scene.add(dir);

// Grid plane for visual reference (can be hidden in OBS)
const grid = new THREE.GridHelper(40, 40, 0x444444, 0x333333);
grid.position.y = -1.5;
scene.add(grid);

// Shared geometry
const cubeSize = 1.2;
const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(cubeSize, cubeSize, cubeSize);

// Generate a canvas texture for labels
function makeLabelTexture(text) {
    const size = 256;
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = size;
    canvas.height = size;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c89f6a'; // wood-ish
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3b2c1e';
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#2b1c10';
    ctx.lineWidth = 8;
    ctx.strokeRect(10, 10, size - 20, size - 20);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
    ctx.font = 'bold 110px system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial';
    ctx.fillText(text, size / 2, size / 2 + 8);
    const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
    texture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
    texture.needsUpdate = true;
    return texture;
}

function loadFaceTexture(label) {
    const url = textureManifest && textureManifest[label];
    if (!url) return Promise.resolve(makeLabelTexture(label));
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const loader = new THREE.TextureLoader();
        loader.load(url, tex => {
            tex.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
            resolve(tex);
        }, undefined, () => resolve(makeLabelTexture(label)));
    });
}
```

```javascript
function makeCircleDiamondFace(text, color, rotateDeg = 0) {
    const size = 256;
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = size; canvas.height = size;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    // rotate full artwork
    ctx.translate(size / 2, size / 2);
    ctx.rotate((rotateDeg * Math.PI) / 180);
    ctx.translate(-size / 2, -size / 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f0e6d8';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);
    // colored circle (use most of face)
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(size / 2, size / 2, size * 0.45, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // white diamond on top
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(size / 2, size / 2);
    ctx.rotate(Math.PI / 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    const d = size * 0.42;
    ctx.fillRect(-d / 2, -d / 2, d, d);
    ctx.restore();
    // note or degree label
    ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
    ctx.font = 'bold 80px system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(text, size / 2, size / 2);
    const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
    tex.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
    tex.needsUpdate = true;
    return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: tex, transparent: true });
}

async function makeMaterials(label, romanLabel) {
    // Front face: chord name label texture (strong bias always facing camera)
    const labelTex = await loadFaceTexture(label);
    const front = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: labelTex, transparent: true });
    const wood = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xd5b38a });

    // Determine ingredients (root,3rd,5th,7th)
    const notes = noteSetsC[romanLabel] || ['-', '-', '-', '-'];
    const display = (labelMode === 'roman') ? notesToDegreesInC(notes) : notes;
    // rotate faces so that a 90° cube rotation around Z keeps diamond labels upright
    const faceBottom = makeCircleDiamondFace(display[0], '#2ecc71', 0);     // root
    const faceRight = makeCircleDiamondFace(display[1], '#e74c3c', 90);     // 3rd
    const faceTop = makeCircleDiamondFace(display[2], '#3498db', 180);      // 5th
    const faceLeft = makeCircleDiamondFace(display[3], '#bdc3c7', -90);     // 7th

    // Face order: [px, nx, py, ny, pz, nz]
    // We'll orient so nz (index 5) is the front-facing chord-name; map sides accordingly
    // left(n x) -> 1; right(p x) -> 0; top(p y) -> 2; bottom(n y) -> 3; front(n z) -> 5; back(p z) -> 4
    const materials = [];
    materials[0] = faceRight; // +x right → 3rd
    materials[1] = faceLeft;  // -x left → 7th
    materials[2] = faceTop;   // +y top → 5th
    materials[3] = faceBottom;// -y bottom → root
    materials[4] = front;     // +z front chord label (toward camera)
    materials[5] = wood;      // -z back
    return materials;
}

// State
const cubes = [];
let currentSet = 'major';
let labelMode = 'roman';
let textureManifest = null;

// Interaction helpers
const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
const pointer = new THREE.Vector2();
let dragging = null;
let dragOffset = new THREE.Vector3();
const plane = new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), 0);

// Grid snapping and lineup spacing
const gridSize = 1.4; // spacing between cubes
function snapToGrid(vec3) {
    vec3.x = Math.round(vec3.x / gridSize) * gridSize;
    vec3.z = Math.round(vec3.z / gridSize) * gridSize;
}

// Active lineup management
let lineup = [];

function computeSlotPositions(n) {
    const startX = -((n - 1) * gridSize) / 2;
    const xs = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) xs.push(startX + i * gridSize);
    return xs;
}

function reflowLineup() {
    const xs = computeSlotPositions(lineup.length);
    lineup.forEach((cube, i) => {
        cube.position.x = xs[i];
        cube.position.y = 0;
        cube.position.z = 0;
    });
}

function removeFromLineup(obj) {
    const idx = lineup.indexOf(obj);
    if (idx >= 0) {
        lineup.splice(idx, 1);
        reflowLineup();
    }
}

function addToLineup(obj, side) {
    if (lineup.includes(obj)) return;
    if (side === 'left') lineup.unshift(obj);
    else lineup.push(obj);
    reflowLineup();
}

function clearCubes() {
    for (const c of cubes) {
        scene.remove(c);
        c.geometry.dispose();
        c.material.forEach(m => {
            if (m.map) m.map.dispose();
            m.dispose();
        });
    }
    cubes.length = 0;
    lineup = [];
}

async function loadSet(setName) {
    clearCubes();
    const data = chordSetsC[setName];
    for (const item of data) {
        const label = item[labelMode];
        const materials = await makeMaterials(label, item.roman);
        const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry.clone(), materials);
        mesh.userData = {
            roman: item.roman,
            letter: item.letter,
            rotationIndex: 0,
        };
        mesh.position.set((Math.random() - 0.5) * 6, 0, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4);
        cubes.push(mesh);
        scene.add(mesh);
    }
    lineup = [...cubes];
    reflowLineup();
}

async function updateLabels() {
    for (const c of cubes) {
        const label = c.userData[labelMode];
        const materials = await makeMaterials(label);
        c.material.forEach(m => { if (m.map) m.map.dispose(); m.dispose(); });
        c.material = materials;
    }
}

// Raycast helpers
function getIntersects(event) {
    const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    pointer.x = ((event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
    pointer.y = -((event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
    raycaster.setFromCamera(pointer, camera);
    return raycaster.intersectObjects(cubes, false);
}

function onPointerDown(e) {
    const hits = getIntersects(e);
    if (hits.length > 0) {
        dragging = hits[0].object;
        const hitPoint = hits[0].point.clone();
        plane.setFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), dragging.position);
        const worldPoint = new THREE.Vector3();
        raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(plane, worldPoint);
        dragOffset.copy(worldPoint).sub(dragging.position);
        controls.enabled = false;
    }
}

function onPointerMove(e) {
    if (!dragging) return;
    const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    pointer.x = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
    pointer.y = -((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
    raycaster.setFromCamera(pointer, camera);
    const worldPoint = new THREE.Vector3();
    if (raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(plane, worldPoint)) {
        const target = worldPoint.sub(dragOffset);
        target.y = 0;
        dragging.position.copy(target);
    }
}

function onPointerUp() {
    if (dragging) {
        // Insert back into lineup at nearest end by x sign (right/left)
        const side = dragging.position.x >= 0 ? 'right' : 'left';
        addToLineup(dragging, side);
    }
    dragging = null;
    controls.enabled = true;
}

function onClick(e) {
    // If drag ended with minimal move, treat as click
    const hits = getIntersects(e);
    if (hits.length > 0) {
        const obj = hits[0].object;
        obj.userData.rotationIndex = (obj.userData.rotationIndex + 1) % 4;
        const inversion = inversionByQuarterTurn[obj.userData.rotationIndex];
        // Do NOT visually rotate the cube; we keep chord face toward camera.
        // In a later step we can animate side-face swapping to reflect inversion if needed.
        console.log('Play chord', { roman: obj.userData.roman, letter: obj.userData.letter, inversion });
    }
}

renderer.domElement.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
    const hits = getIntersects(e);
    if (hits.length > 0) {
        dragging = hits[0].object;
        // Remove from lineup immediately so others close the gap
        removeFromLineup(dragging);
        const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
        pointer.x = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
        pointer.y = -((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
        raycaster.setFromCamera(pointer, camera);
        const worldPoint = new THREE.Vector3();
        plane.setFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), dragging.position);
        raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(plane, worldPoint);
        dragOffset.copy(worldPoint).sub(dragging.position);
        controls.enabled = false;
    }
});
renderer.domElement.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove);
window.addEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp);
renderer.domElement.addEventListener('click', onClick);

// UI wiring
const setSelect = document.getElementById('set-select');
const labelSelect = document.getElementById('label-mode');
document.getElementById('arrange-btn').addEventListener('click', reflowLineup);
document.getElementById('reset-btn').addEventListener('click', () => loadSet(currentSet));

setSelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
    currentSet = setSelect.value;
    loadSet(currentSet);
});

labelSelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
    labelMode = labelSelect.value;
    updateLabels();
});

function onResize() {
    camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
}
window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);

// Initial: try to load texture manifest mapping { label: url }
fetch('./textures/manifest.json')
    .then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : null)
    .then(j => { textureManifest = j || null; loadSet(currentSet); })
    .catch(() => loadSet(currentSet));

// Animation loop
function animate() {
    controls.update();
    renderer.render(scene, camera);
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}
animate();
```

```javascript
// Tiny tween system for smooth animations
const activeTweens = [];
function easeInOutCubic(t) {
    return t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2;
}
function tweenObject({ duration = 800, onUpdate, onComplete, ease = easeInOutCubic }) {
    const start = performance.now();
    const tw = { cancelled: false };
    tw.tick = (now) => {
        if (tw.cancelled) return true;
        const t = Math.min(1, (now - start) / duration);
        const v = ease(t);
        onUpdate && onUpdate(v);
        if (t >= 1) { onComplete && onComplete(); return true; }
        return false;
    };
    activeTweens.push(tw);
    return tw;
}
function animatePosition(obj, to, duration = 700) {
    const from = obj.position.clone();
    return tweenObject({ duration, onUpdate: (v) => {
        obj.position.lerpVectors(from, to, v);
    }});
}
function animateQuaternion(obj, toQuat, duration = 900) {
    const fromQuat = obj.quaternion.clone();
    const to = toQuat.clone();
    return tweenObject({ duration, onUpdate: (v) => {
        THREE.Quaternion.slerp(fromQuat, to, obj.quaternion, v);
    }});
}

    const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);

function snapToGrid(vec3) {
    vec3.x = Math.round(vec3.x / gridSize) * gridSize;
    vec3.z = Math.round(vec3.z / gridSize) * gridSize;
}

// Active lineup management
let lineup = [];

function computeSlotPositions(n) {
    const startX = -((n - 1) * gridSize) / 2;
    const xs = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) xs.push(startX + i * gridSize);
    return xs;
}

function reflowLineup() {
    const xs = computeSlotPositions(lineup.length);
    lineup.forEach((cube, i) => {
        const target = new THREE.Vector3(xs[i], 0, 0);
        animatePosition(cube, target, 650);
    });
}

function removeFromLineup(obj) {
    const idx = lineup.indexOf(obj);
    if (idx >= 0) {
        lineup.splice(idx, 1);
        reflowLineup();
    }
}

function addToLineup(obj, side) {
    if (lineup.includes(obj)) return;
    if (side === 'left') lineup.unshift(obj);
    else lineup.push(obj);
    reflowLineup();
}

function clearCubes() {
    for (const c of cubes) {
        scene.remove(c);
        c.geometry.dispose();
        c.material.forEach(m => {
            if (m.map) m.map.dispose();
            m.dispose();
        });
    }
    cubes.length = 0;
    lineup = [];
}

async function loadSet(setName) {
    clearCubes();
    const data = chordSetsC[setName];
    for (const item of data) {
        const label = item[labelMode];
        const materials = await makeMaterials(label, item.roman);
        const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry.clone(), materials);
        mesh.userData = {
            roman: item.roman,
            letter: item.letter,
            rotationIndex: 0,
        };
        mesh.position.set((Math.random() - 0.5) * 6, 0, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4);
        mesh.quaternion.identity();
        cubes.push(mesh);
        scene.add(mesh);
    }
    lineup = [...cubes];
    reflowLineup();
}

async function updateLabels() {
    for (const c of cubes) {
        const label = c.userData[labelMode];
        const materials = await makeMaterials(label);
        c.material.forEach(m => { if (m.map) m.map.dispose(); m.dispose(); });
        c.material = materials;
    }
}

// Raycast helpers
function getIntersects(event) {
    const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    pointer.x = ((event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
    pointer.y = -((event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
    raycaster.setFromCamera(pointer, camera);
    return raycaster.intersectObjects(cubes, false);
}

function onPointerDown(e) {
    const hits = getIntersects(e);
    if (hits.length > 0) {
        dragging = hits[0].object;
        const hitPoint = hits[0].point.clone();
        plane.setFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), dragging.position);
        const worldPoint = new THREE.Vector3();
        raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(plane, worldPoint);
        dragOffset.copy(worldPoint).sub(dragging.position);
        controls.enabled = false;
    }
}

function onPointerMove(e) {
    if (!dragging) return;
    const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    pointer.x = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
    pointer.y = -((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
    raycaster.setFromCamera(pointer, camera);
    const worldPoint = new THREE.Vector3();
    if (raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(plane, worldPoint)) {
        const target = worldPoint.sub(dragOffset);
        target.y = 0;
        dragging.position.copy(target);
    }
}

function onPointerUp() {
    if (dragging) {
        // Insert back into lineup at nearest end by x sign (right/left)
        const side = dragging.position.x >= 0 ? 'right' : 'left';
        addToLineup(dragging, side);
    }
    dragging = null;
    controls.enabled = true;
}

function targetQuaternionForFaceNormal(normal) {
    // normal is in object space; map to one of the 6 axis-aligned faces
    const n = normal.clone();
    // Determine dominant axis
    const ax = Math.abs(n.x), ay = Math.abs(n.y), az = Math.abs(n.z);
    let face = '+z';
    if (ax > ay && ax > az) face = n.x > 0 ? '+x' : '-x';
    else if (ay > ax && ay > az) face = n.y > 0 ? '+y' : '-y';
    else face = n.z > 0 ? '+z' : '-z';

    const q = new THREE.Quaternion();
    switch (face) {
        case '+z': q.identity(); break;
        case '-z': q.setFromAxisAngle(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), Math.PI); break;
        case '+x': q.setFromAxisAngle(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), -Math.PI / 2); break;
        case '-x': q.setFromAxisAngle(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), Math.PI / 2); break;
        case '+y': q.setFromAxisAngle(new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0), Math.PI / 2); break;
        case '-y': q.setFromAxisAngle(new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0), -Math.PI / 2); break;
    }
    return q;
}

function onClick(e) {
    const hits = getIntersects(e);
    if (!hits.length) return;
    const hit = hits[0];
    const obj = hit.object;
    // If front face was clicked, spin 90° around Y for next inversion
    const faceNormal = hit.face.normal.clone(); // local space
    const targetQ = targetQuaternionForFaceNormal(faceNormal);
    // Determine if face is +z (front)
    if (Math.abs(faceNormal.z - 1) < 0.5) {
        obj.userData.rotationIndex = (obj.userData.rotationIndex + 1) % 4;
        const extra = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromAxisAngle(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), Math.PI / 2);
        const finalQ = obj.quaternion.clone().multiply(extra);
        animateQuaternion(obj, finalQ, 900);
        const inversion = inversionByQuarterTurn[obj.userData.rotationIndex];
        console.log('Play chord', { roman: obj.userData.roman, letter: obj.userData.letter, inversion });
    } else {
        // Rotate cube so the clicked face comes to the front (+Z)
        animateQuaternion(obj, targetQ, 900);
    }
}

renderer.domElement.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
    const hits = getIntersects(e);
    if (hits.length > 0) {
        dragging = hits[0].object;
        // Remove from lineup immediately so others close the gap
        removeFromLineup(dragging);
        const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
        pointer.x = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
        pointer.y = -((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
        raycaster.setFromCamera(pointer, camera);
        const worldPoint = new THREE.Vector3();
        plane.setFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), dragging.position);
        raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(plane, worldPoint);
        dragOffset.copy(worldPoint).sub(dragging.position);
        controls.enabled = false;
    }
});
renderer.domElement.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove);
window.addEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp);
renderer.domElement.addEventListener('click', onClick);

// UI wiring
const setSelect = document.getElementById('set-select');
const labelSelect = document.getElementById('label-mode');
document.getElementById('arrange-btn').addEventListener('click', reflowLineup);
document.getElementById('reset-btn').addEventListener('click', () => loadSet(currentSet));

setSelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
    currentSet = setSelect.value;
    loadSet(currentSet);
});

labelSelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
    labelMode = labelSelect.value;
    updateLabels();
});

function onResize() {
    camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
}
window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);

// Initial: try to load texture manifest mapping { label: url }
fetch('./textures/manifest.json')
    .then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : null)
    .then(j => { textureManifest = j || null; loadSet(currentSet); })
    .catch(() => loadSet(currentSet));

// Animation loop
function animate() {
    controls.update();
    // drive tweens
    const now = performance.now();
    for (let i = activeTweens.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const done = activeTweens[i].tick(now);
        if (done) activeTweens.splice(i, 1);
    }
    renderer.render(scene, camera);
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}
animate();



```
